as_told.title: SDI as backdoor for UAP programs

plain: Ronald Reagan's Strategic Defense Initiative, the missile defence plan announced in 1983, was likely a back door to pay for secret programmes on UAP, the official term for unidentified flying objects, and to act "offensively against UAP". That is the view of a researcher who goes by UAPGerb, speaking to Michels. He gives it once as his own reading of the history, without naming a source. He gives it once as something he heard from unnamed sources during his projects. If true, it would mean a famous Cold War weapons plan also hid money and a military aim aimed at unknown craft.
